THE EASTSIDE’S PREMIER AWARD-WINNING FIRM
100% Woman-Owned Design-Build Remodeling Excellence

We want what you want: A stellar finished project that showcases exceptional design and quality craftsmanship.  To deliver the space of your dreams, we’ll listen to your needs and customize our design and selections to exceed your expectations for your home. Nip Tuck Remodeling is genuinely interested in doing right by our clients every time and we accomplish this by following these three simple steps.

Deliberately
Designed

We don’t stop at “fine.” We push boundaries, explore possibilities, and craft solutions that are as practical as they are beautiful.

The result? A deliberately designed space that feels so natural you’ll wonder why it wasn’t always built this way.

Expertly
Crafted

Bringing your remodel to life takes a symphony of talent, from project managers who orchestrate the entire process to trusted artisans who execute with precision.

At Nip Tuck, the build is every bit as thoughtful as the design.

Uniquely
Yours

No two families are alike, and no two Nip Tuck remodeling projects are, either.

The result is a home so distinctively yours, you’ll never see it repeated next door.

Discover The Nip Tuck Difference
Luxury Remodeling Without The Usual Frustration

For many homeowners in Bellevue and across Seattle’s Eastside, remodeling begins with inspiration but quickly becomes complicated. Homeowners often find themselves navigating unclear timelines, disconnected contractors, endless design decisions, and uncertainty about how their investment will evolve once construction begins.

A poorly coordinated remodel can leave even beautiful spaces feeling disjointed or disconnected from how a family actually lives. Trendy finishes that age quickly, and fragmented communication between designers and builders can create frustration long before the project is complete.

At Nip Tuck Remodeling, thoughtful remodeling should create clarity, not chaos. Every project begins with intention — because homeowners deserve a process that feels as considered as the result.

Our approach to luxury remodeling is rooted in listening first. Every home has its own rhythm and lifestyle needs. Instead of applying one-size-fits-all solutions, we help homeowners create spaces designed around how they truly live today and how they want to live years from now.

YOUR REMODELING EXPERTS
100% Engaged & Focused on You

Remodeling your family home is an emotional journey involving change, significant investment and the excitement for the infinite possibilities of what your space could be.  We believe that if you choose to take on a project this significant, every step in the process should exceed your expectations. When you choose Nip Tuck Remodeling, you can expect a dedicated team of experienced and empathetic individuals who are committed to giving you the remodel of your dreams.

Breaking Down A More Intentional Remodeling Process

A successful remodel is not defined by demolition day alone. The strongest outcomes are shaped during the collaboration and decision-making that happen long before construction begins.

At Nip Tuck Remodeling, our design-build process brings design and construction under one roof from the start, creating better continuity between vision, planning, craftsmanship, and long-term investment. This integrated approach allows homeowners throughout the Eastside communities to move forward with greater confidence and clarity during a full-house remodel, a kitchen remodel, or a bathroom remodel.

A thoughtful remodeling process often includes:

 

Understanding how the home currently functions day to day
Identifying opportunities to improve flow and organization
Prioritizing long-term livability over short-lived trends
Coordinating selections early to support scheduling and investment
Creating continuity between existing and newly remodeled spaces
Designing around entertaining, remote work, wellness, or multigenerational living

For homeowners investing in custom remodeling or interior home remodeling, thoughtful planning becomes part of the creative process itself. Deliberate decisions made early can help reduce unnecessary changes later while supporting a more cohesive final result.

Rather than treating remodeling as a series of isolated upgrades, we approach every entire home remodel as an opportunity to create a home that feels balanced, timeless, and uniquely personal.

Remodeling With Long-Term Living In Mind

Luxury remodeling is not simply about creating beautiful rooms. It is about improving how a home supports everyday living over time. Many homeowners today are looking beyond surface-level updates and prioritizing functionality and comfort that can evolve alongside their families.

Thoughtful custom renovations and luxury home remodeling projects may include:

 

Flexible spaces that adapt to changing routines
Integrated storage that reduces visual clutter
Kitchens designed for gathering and connection
Spa-inspired bathrooms that encourage relaxation
Layered lighting for comfort and atmosphere
Materials selected for durability and timeless appeal

At Nip Tuck Remodeling, the best remodeling projects are the ones that continue to feel intentional years after construction is complete.

What Is Design-Build Remodeling?

A design-build remodeling firm is a company that provides both design and construction services under a single contract. The design-build model differs from the traditional design-bid-build model, in which the design and construction phases are typically performed by separate entities. The design-build model differs from the traditional design-bid-build model, in which the design and construction phases are typically performed by separate entities. In design-build, the firm takes responsibility for both the design and construction of a project, streamlining the process and often resulting in cost and time savings.

Design-Build for Intentional Living in Woodinville and Seattle's Eastside

Thoughtful design-build remodeling helps homeowners create spaces that feel more natural to live in every day. When our designers and builders collaborate from the beginning, decisions are made with both appearance and functionality in mind.

At Nip Tuck Remodeling, we look closely at how homeowners actually use their space. That may involve improving kitchen flow, creating quieter areas to unwind, adjusting layouts for remote work, or making everyday routines feel less cramped and stressful. For many families in Woodinville, WA, long-term planning is also an important part of the remodeling process. Some want layouts that remain comfortable as they age. Others need more flexibility for changing family routines or growing households.

Because Nip Tuck Remodeling manages both design and construction, we can anticipate how each decision affects the overall layout before work begins. This level of foresight transforms a remodel from a cosmetic update into a lifestyle upgrade, one that reduces daily stress and brings a sense of ease back into your home.

Why Choose a Design-Build Remodeling Firm?

According to the Design-Build Institute of America, “Design-build continues to out-perform other delivery systems in cost, schedule, growth measures, construction and delivery speed.”

Homeowners who choose to work with a design-build remodeling firm spend 3.9% less on projects that are completed 13% more quickly. When you choose a design-build firm, you are choosing to work with and trust one team to manage your entire project. Design-build is more efficient, and it will save you money.

As one firm, we guide you from the initial design phase in which ideas are developed and turn them into your newly remodeled home during the build phase. In this way, we can more accurately calculate the financial investment and the time necessary to complete the project.

We also share common resources with everyone working on your home, so that we can monitor the drawings and build plans for feasibility and accuracy. The legwork we do up front keeps costs real, and while expenses might look high in comparison to other designers and contractors, you’ll discover that you will be least frustrated with overall expenses when taking into consideration surprise costs that are ultimately a part of a home remodel.

Design-Build for Phased Remodeling

Not every homeowner is ready for a full home remodel, and that’s where phased planning becomes invaluable. A well‑structured design‑build approach allows you to improve your home in stages without sacrificing continuity or long‑term vision.

Our role as a design-build remodeling firm is to help you see the bigger picture. Even if you begin with a single space, we consider how future projects may connect. That means selecting materials that will still match future phases, planning electrical layouts with expansion in mind, or avoiding design choices that may limit future options.

This approach is especially beneficial for Eastside homeowners who want to invest strategically over time. Whether you start with a kitchen or a single living space, phased remodeling allows you to build toward a unified, intentional home without the pressure of doing everything at once. And because design and construction are managed by one integrated team, each phase stays on schedule and aligned with your long‑term goals.

Benefits of Working with a Design-Build Firm

Design-build firms offer a more comprehensive solution to home design and construction services because the team is all under one house. We are consistently on the same page about your project from start to finish. This benefits the homeowner because the cost is accurately calculated before the work starts.

The main benefits of design-build include:

Single Point of Responsibility

The firm takes responsibility for both the design and construction of the project, which simplifies communication and reduces the risk of miscommunication or delays.

Streamlined Process
Design-build firms provide a seamless and efficient process, as the design and construction are integrated. This often results in faster project completion times. We work hard on the design phase to ensure we’ve anticipated all of your needs and taken into consideration any complexities regarding materials. We don’t start the build until after the design is complete and approved. 
Improved Cost Control

Design-build firms bring design and construction professionals together in a collaborative environment, leading to better coordination and improved quality. The design-build approach allows course correction in design sooner in the process, eliminating the need for numerous redesigns and projects cost escalations because design and build teams are working collaboratively. We lead homeowners through the process confidently, eliminating the surprises that can come up during a more traditional approach due to either lack of planning ahead or by not thoroughly exploring potential surprises before construction begins. The traditional design-bid-build model works for some, but it is almost always missing the details that drive actual cost from over-designed spaces.

Reduced Risk
Many people don’t realize that some contractors will build on the fly without any drawings or plans to work from. Others will simply draw up a design, hand it to you, and leave you to find someone to do the work. If there are any small mistakes, undeclared assumptions, or undiscovered damage to the home, you end up with a whole new set of problems and no one to turn to.
Design-Build Remodeling Firms Streamline Home Remodeling

Design-build firms manage your home remodeling project in a way that causes you the least amount of stress. Instead of coordinating between contractors and subcontractors or having to find your own builder, you have a single point of contact and a single budget. If you have any questions during any part of the project, you can take them to your project manager. This approach makes it easier for you to manage your home remodeling project, because everything to do with the design and the build are addressed through one project manager who is responsible for obtaining all of the materials and scheduling all of the work. The design-build team starts and finishes the project in partnership with you.  

The Nip-Tuck Approach to Design-Build Remodeling
What makes Nip Tuck Remodeling  unique?
 Nip Tuck Remodeling is a woman-owned design-build firm.
We are expert planners that use a purposeful method to produce reliable, predictable results.
We limit the number of projects we run concurrently to provide better service and communication with clients.
Nip Tuck, April Bettinger, and several members of our team have been regularly recognized for their beautiful and unique designs, responsible corporate citizenship, and being among the best – not only in the greater Seattle area, but nationwide.
In 2020, we founded Nip Tuck Cares, donating $30,000+ per year to volunteer, fund safe housing programs for homeless and low-income families, and support workforce education and development in our community.
Explore Our Design-Build Process
Ready to Begin Your Transformation?

If you’re exploring the idea of remodeling, our team is here to guide you with clarity, empathy, and a predictable process. Connect with Nip Tuck Remodeling to begin shaping a home that’s deliberately designed, expertly crafted, delivered with complete confidence, and perfect for long-term use.

Full Home Remodeling on Seattle's Eastside

Nip Tuck Neighborhoods

Eastside homes offer so much: tight-knit communities, beautiful surroundings, and established neighborhoods that attract people and make them want to stay. But a home that hasn’t been updated in years can start to feel like it’s holding you back. Nip Tuck Remodeling works with homeowners across the Eastside who are ready for a full home remodel that brings their living space in line with how they actually want to live and who want a team that takes that goal seriously from day one.

One Team. Every Stage. No Surprises.

A full house remodel is only as good as the process behind it. Nip Tuck Remodeling’s integrated design-build model means design and construction come together under one roof from the very first conversation, eliminating the gaps between vision and execution that typically cause delays and cost overruns. The result is a home that reflects your life rather than a compromise between what you wanted and what you got.

Eastside Seattle Home Remodeling:

Nip Tuck Remodeling is a woman-owned design-build firm serving Eastside Seattle homeowners in Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Sammamish, and neighboring communities with whole-home, kitchen, and bathroom remodeling.

Explore the Eastside neighborhoods where Nip Tuck Remodeling plans, designs, and delivers thoughtfully executed home remodels for discerning homeowners.

Full-Home Interior Remodeling

A full-home remodel is your opportunity to make every part of your Bellevue, Woodinville, or Sammamish, area home exactly what you want. Whether it’s the entire home, complete floor, or a collection of rooms, we focus on improving flow and function while updating with new and improved materials and color palettes. 

In addition to reimaging layouts and repurposing rooms, whole-home remodels often include things like updating flooring, replacing or updating the millwork and doors, transforming an existing fireplace or staircase, or adding exterior doors & windows.

View Our Portfolio
When Your Home No Longer Fits Your Life

A house that made sense five years ago does not always make sense today. As families grow and lifestyles shift, spaces that once worked can start to feel less functional and more out of step with everyday life. For Bellevue, WA, homeowners who have outgrown their floor plan or want a home that finally reflects who they are, a full home remodel with Nip Tuck Remodeling is one that’s worth considering.

More than a Renovation

A full house remodel from Nip Tuck Remodeling goes far beyond cosmetic updates. We begin by understanding how your home truly functions—how you move through each space, where natural light falls, and which areas go unused and why. From there, every decision is intentional: reimagined layouts, repurposed rooms, updated millwork, new flooring, transformed staircases, and refreshed palettes. The result is a home that works as beautifully as it looks—cohesive, expertly crafted, and distinctly yours.

Designed and Built by One Team

One of the biggest frustrations homeowners face in a large remodel is the disconnect between the designer and the builder. Nip Tuck Remodeling eliminates that through a design-build approach where both disciplines work as one unified team from day one. Design decisions are informed by construction realities, and budget conversations happen early. More importantly, the vision you start with is the one that gets built.

A Premier Woman-Owned Remodeling Firm Serving Bellevue

Nip Tuck Remodeling is an award-winning, woman-owned firm with a reputation for intentional design, expert craftsmanship, and genuine care for the homeowners they work with. Whether you’re looking for a full home remodel, a kitchen remodel, or a bathroom remodel, we’re here to help. Ready to take the first step? Get in touch with us today to learn more.

KITCHENS
Your Dream Kitchen Is Our Specialty

Today’s kitchen is so much more than an area to store and prep food; it is a multifunctional space that rests at the heart of the home. It serves as the place where people gather to share a meal, entertain guests, celebrate birthdays and holidays, do homework, and even video conference for work or school. 

Because kitchen remodeling is our specialty, you can expect a design that is functional, beautiful, and tailored to how you use the space. Your new Seattle area kitchen might include:

Custom cabinetry
A spacious island
Stunning countertops
High-end appliances
Durable flooring
A functional layout
Task, statement, and undercabinet lighting
Backsplash and tile detailing
And more!
View Our Portfolio
Timeless Kitchen Design That Lasts

A kitchen should feel intentional and balanced. At Nip Tuck Remodeling, timeless design begins with understanding how you live and how your kitchen supports the rhythm of your day. Many kitchen remodels lose their appeal because they rely on trending styles or materials that don’t age well.

Our approach is more thoughtful and grounded in long‑term value. We study the architecture of your home and the way your family uses the space before recommending any finishes. This ensures every choice (from cabinet design to countertop materials) contributes to a cohesive, lasting aesthetic.

Homeowners on Seattle’s Eastside often want a kitchen that feels warm and uncluttered. Timeless design supports that goal by emphasizing proportion, durability, craftsmanship, and materials that hold up beautifully over time. Whether you’re planning a single kitchen renovation or a full home remodel, this philosophy protects your investment and ensures your kitchen remains relevant for years to come.

Luxury Features for Everyday Living

A well‑designed kitchen should make daily life easier and more beautiful. That’s why we curate features that blend performance with refinement. Integrated appliances create a seamless look while improving workflow. Custom cabinetry maximizes storage and eliminates visual clutter. High‑quality surfaces (such as quartzite, porcelain and hardwood) offer both elegance and long‑term durability.

Lighting also plays a major role in the overall feel of a kitchen. Rather than depending on a single overhead fixture, we create a layered lighting plan that supports different activities throughout the day. The result is a space that provides clear visibility for meal preparation while offering a comfortable, inviting atmosphere for gatherings and everyday routines.

Every kitchen should reflect the way it is used. For homeowners who enjoy entertaining, we can incorporate features that make hosting more convenient and enjoyable. For families, we focus on creating a layout that supports daily activities and helps the kitchen function comfortably during busy routines.

Because our designers and builders work as one unified team, every detail is coordinated early. This reduces stress and ensures your kitchen is both beautiful and buildable.

Ready to Transform Your Kitchen?

If you’re considering a remodel, our team is here to guide you with clarity and a predictable
process. Connect with Nip Tuck Remodeling to start planning a kitchen that’s deliberately
designed and delivered with complete confidence.

Get In Touch

Nip Tuck Remodeling is a premier woman-owned design-build remodeling contractor serving Seattle’s Eastside, including Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Sammamish, Mercer Island, Bridle Trails, Clyde Hill, Cottage Lake, and Woodinville. Specializing in comprehensive whole-home remodeling services, the firm transforms entire homes and multi-room spaces with thoughtful planning, improved flow, and updated materials that reflect homeowners’ lifestyles. Known for its intentional design approach, expert craftsmanship, and seamless end-to-end project management, Nip Tuck delivers renovation solutions that enhance both beauty and function throughout Eastside residences.

Escape to your personal retreat, leave behind the stress of the day or get your morning off to a beautiful start. Your bathroom can be a sanctuary where you set aside everything to pamper yourself. That starts with amazing tilework, completed by craftspeople with a passion for detail and carries over to the finishing touches of gorgeous lighting, fixtures and hardware. Timeless Bathroom Design

A bathroom should feel comfortable years from now, not just immediately after the remodel is finished. At Nip Tuck Remodeling, we focus on designs that balance appearance with long-term practicality instead of relying on short-lived trends.

Before recommending finishes or layouts, we look at how the space is used every day. Natural light, room proportions, storage needs, and traffic flow all play a role in the design process. Small details matter too. Tile size, hardware finishes, and material textures need to work together so the room feels cohesive rather than overly designed. Homeowners in Bellevue and throughout the Eastside want bathrooms that feel uncluttered and easy to maintain. Timeless design supports that goal by emphasizing proportion, balance, and materials that hold up beautifully over time.

Whether you’re planning a single bathroom renovation or a full home remodel, this philosophy protects your investment and ensures your space feels relevant for years to come.

Functional Planning for Everyday Living

A beautiful bathroom only succeeds when it works effortlessly for your routines. That’s why we design with lifestyle at the center. Many homeowners come to us feeling overwhelmed by cluttered counters, poor lighting, or layouts that simply don’t fit their needs. Our team focuses on practical improvements that make the room easier to use day to day. We also consider long‑term comfort: zero‑threshold showers, heated floors, ergonomic vanity heights, and durable materials that stand up to daily use, all without changing the overall style of the bathroom.

Because our designers and builders work together throughout the project, every detail is coordinated before construction begins. This helps reduce stress, eliminate surprises, avoid unnecessary revisions, and ensure the finished space performs exactly as intended.

One-Room Remodels with Full-Home Thinking

Nip Tuck Remodeling offers one-room remodels for homeowners who want to focus on a single space right now, while still planning with the whole home in mind through our design-build process.

Utilizing a streamlined version of the award-winning Nip Tuck process, we provide the same high-quality approach to full home remodels and kitchen remodels that the company is known for, but tailored for smaller-scale projects. We bring our experienced team, attention to detail, and commitment to creating lifelong clients to your home. We are excited to help homeowners throughout the Eastside of Seattle transform their living spaces, whether through updating one room or complete home renovations.

Small Space, Big Impact

Your home may not need a full home remodel, but one room can still transform how you live every day. We approach each one-room remodel with the same planning, craftsmanship, and project management that define our larger projects.

A one-room renovation can influence the entire feel of your home. A staircase update brightens the entry. A refreshed powder room elevates the experience for every guest. A redesigned laundry room streamlines routines and reduces daily stress.

These spaces may be compact, but they shape how your home functions. When thoughtfully designed, they become anchors of comfort, efficiency, and beauty. Our work often includes custom built-ins, improved lighting, durable surfaces, and layout adjustments that make the most of every inch.

For Eastside homeowners planning a phased approach to home remodeling, a single-room transformation can set the foundation for a future full-home remodel. By establishing continuity in materials, lighting, and design intent, each project builds toward a cohesive whole.

The Design-Build Advantage

A one-room remodel may be focused in scope, but it still carries the same emotional weight as any larger project. When a space isn’t functioning well, a dated powder room, a dark staircase, a cluttered laundry room, it affects your daily rhythm more than you realize. That’s why even small transformations deserve thoughtful planning, clear communication, and a predictable process.

At Nip Tuck Remodeling, our design-build approach brings clarity to homeowners who want meaningful change without the complexity of a full renovation. Because our designers and builders work as one unified team, every detail is coordinated early. This eliminates the handoffs that often cause delays, miscommunication, and budget surprises.

For homeowners in Bellevue and throughout the Eastside, this level of organization is especially valuable. Many Eastside homes evolve, and a single space can be the first step toward a long-term vision. Whether you’re refreshing a powder room or modernizing a fireplace, our process ensures the space is both beautiful and buildable, and completed with confidence.

Remodeling Redefined, Applied to One Room

Our Remodeling Redefined philosophy is built on deliberately designed spaces, thoughtful planning, and meticulous execution—and that applies just as much to one-room remodels as full home remodels. We start by understanding how you use the room today, what isn’t working, and how you want it to feel and function going forward, then translate that into a design that balances aesthetics, performance, and budget.

If you’re considering a focused update, our team is here to guide you with clarity, creativity, and a predictable process. Connect with Nip Tuck Remodeling to start planning a space that’s deliberately designed, expertly crafted, and delivered with complete confidence.

Designed

We carefully consider how your family lives, how each room should flow, and how your home will function for decades to come.

A deliberately designed space feels so natural you’ll wonder why it wasn’t always built this way.

Crafted

Every element is carefully planned, scheduled, and finished with an eye for detail. Our clients see the stunning results, but behind the scenes lies expert craftsmanship, seamless coordination, and an unwavering commitment to excellence.

At Nip Tuck, the build is every bit as thoughtful as the design.

Uniquely
Yours

No two families are alike, and no two Nip Tuck remodeling projects are, either. We create homes that reflect your personal style, honor the character of your architecture, and support the way you live every day.

From custom layouts to the smallest finishing touches, every detail is chosen with you in mind.

The result is a home so distinctively yours, you’ll never see it repeated next door.

It’s not just a remodel. It’s your vision, brought to life.

In Happiness Guaranteed: A Successful Remodel Doesn’t Happen by Accident, Nip Tuck Remodeling founder April Bettinger shares the mindset, planning process, and practical tools that turn an overwhelming remodel into one homeowners actually enjoy — the same approach that’s guided Eastside families from first idea to a finished home they love.

This is more than a design book. It’s a behind-the-scenes look at the deliberately designed process behind Nip Tuck Remodeling’s Happiness Guaranteed promise — translated into clear steps any homeowner can follow. Whether you’re planning a whole-home remodel, a single-room renovation, or you’re still in the dreaming stage, this book gives you a framework to make confident decisions and keep your project aligned with what matters most to you.

A remodel is one of the largest investments you’ll make in your home. This book is one of the smallest, and it’s written to protect every dollar you invest.

Happiness Guaranteed: A Successful Remodel Doesn’t Happen by Accident is available on Amazon.

5 out of 5 stars
Unexpectedly riveting…I Laughed, I Cried, I Learned

I wasn’t planning to read Happiness Guaranteed on a sunny Saturday afternoon. I had just grabbed it from the mailbox and tossed it on the counter. But one quick peek turned into an afternoon of nonstop reading. I devoured it cover to cover in just a few hours. I laughed, I cried (yes, twice…over a remodeling book!), and walked away genuinely changed. It’s smart, funny, unexpectedly emotional, and packed with real-world wisdom you can use both in a remodel and in life. April Bettinger nailed it, delivering practical remodeling guidelines wrapped in the surprisingly heartfelt journeys of past clients. What an unexpected, wonderful surprise. Highly recommend – absolutely worth the read!

What Happiness Guaranteed Means in Practice

The phrase “Happiness Guaranteed” has been part of Nip Tuck Remodeling for years—but the book goes deeper into what that promise actually looks like from a homeowner’s perspective. It explores how clear expectations, thoughtfully designed flow, and a disciplined, design-build process work together to deliver remodels that feel as good to live with as they look.

You’ll see how Nip Tuck’s eight-step process, weekly communication, and planning-first approach were developed to reduce surprises, avoid decision fatigue, and keep projects on time and on budget. The book shows that “happiness, guaranteed” isn’t about perfection; it’s about a remodel that aligns with your why.

Inside the Book: From “Why” to Walkthrough

Start With Your Why – A guided approach to uncovering the real reasons behind your remodel, so every decision is built around how you actually live, not just what looks good in photos.

Choose the Right Partner – How the design-build model works, how to evaluate firms, the questions to ask, and the red flags to watch for before you sign anything.

Plan and Budget Before You Demo – What real pre-construction looks like: design, product selection, an honest budget, and the planning discipline that keeps projects on time and on budget.

From First Wall Down to Final Walkthrough – What actually happens once construction begins, from staying on track, handling the inevitable surprises, preparing your household, and finishing well, all the way through the final walkthrough and beyond.

5 out of 5 stars
Thinking of remodeling? Read this book!

This book is a valuable guide for anyone planning a remodel and for the teams bringing those visions to life. From concept to completion, the author and her team fostered a collaborative process that built confidence and clarity at every step. The result was not only a home we love, but a genuinely rewarding and enjoyable experience. At the heart of it all was a foundation of trust that made the remodel a seamless partnership and exceeded every expectation. This author has put into words our remodeling experience.

Who Happiness Guaranteed Is For

Happiness Guaranteed: A Successful Remodel Doesn’t Happen by Accident is written for homeowners who know their home isn’t working as well as it should — whether you’re ready to take the plunge or still in the early stages of thinking about it. It’s especially helpful if you’re considering a whole-home remodel, kitchen remodel, or primary bathroom renovation and want to approach it with clarity and confidence, and without the regret so many homeowners live with afterward.

By the end, you’ll understand the process, know how to recognize a true professional, and trust the plan before the first wall comes down.

It’s also written for fellow remodeling professionals looking to elevate how they serve their own clients — and for anyone who wants to see how a well-structured process turns “fine” houses into homes people genuinely love.

Not Ready to Buy the Book Yet but Thinking About Remodeling? Get Our Free Guide.

Most of the decisions that lead to remodeling regret happen before construction starts. The wrong partner. A budget that was never realistic. Choices made without enough information or time to think. This free guide includes a condensed chapter from Happiness Guaranteed: A Successful Remodel Doesn’t Happen by Accident written by April Bettinger, founder of Nip Tuck Remodeling, sharing her experiences guiding Eastside homeowners through the process for more than two decades. You’ll also receive the Remodeling Partner Evaluation Scorecard so you can compare the firms you speak with before you sign anything.

About the Author

April, founder and owner of Nip Tuck Remodeling, is a design-build leader known for whole-house interiors, kitchen transformations, and primary bathroom renovations on Seattle’s Eastside. Over the years, she’s refined a remodeling process that blends design, construction, and communication into a single, predictable experience for her clients.

Happiness Guaranteed: A Successful Remodel Doesn’t Happen by Accident distills that experience into a book homeowners can use long before they ever sign a contract—so they can approach their projects with more clarity, less stress, and a stronger sense of what’s possible.

How to Get Happiness Guaranteed

Happiness Guaranteed is available in digital and print versions on Amazon. When you purchase the book, you get access to custom-made worksheets designed to help you work through the process of determining your why, questions to ask to help you select the right design-build partner, a scorecard for comparing design-build firms,  a budget planning worksheet, and a homeowner preparation checklist.

For Current and Future Nip Tuck Clients

Many of our clients read Happiness Guaranteed before or during their projects as a way to better understand each stage of our process and the decisions we’ll make together. It’s a shared reference point that helps you feel prepared, ask better questions, and keep the focus on what will truly make you happy in your home long after construction is complete.

Whether you end up working with Nip Tuck or another firm, the book is designed to help you approach remodeling with more confidence, clarity, and intention

Frequently Asked Questions About the Home Remodeling Process
What should I do before hiring a remodeling company?

The most important thing you can do before hiring anyone is get clear on why you want to remodel and what a successful outcome actually looks like for your household — not just the finishes and the layout, but how the space needs to function and what you’ll be glad you did five years from now. That clarity shapes every conversation that follows and protects you from making decisions under pressure later.

From there, the preparation that matters most is understanding the process you’re about to enter. How does the firm handle design? How do they build a budget? How complete is the plan before construction starts? The homeowners who have the most predictable, least stressful renovation experiences are the ones who asked the right questions early, chose their team carefully, and understood what they were committing to before anyone broke ground. Happiness Guaranteed gives you that foundation before you call anyone, sign anything, or make a single design decision.

WHAT SETS US APART
Sixteen Years. Fifty Awards. One Standard of Care.

Nip Tuck Remodeling has been transforming homes on Seattle’s Eastside since 2010. We’re a women-owned design-build firm specializing in whole-home remodels, kitchen transformations, and primary bathroom renovations — and we’ve spent sixteen years earning the trust of homeowners in Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Woodinville, Sammamish, and Mercer Island. Our work has been recognized with more than 50 regional and national awards, including the Remodeling Big50 and national Chrysalis Awards. More importantly, it’s been recognized by the clients who live in it every day.

About Nip Tuck Remodeling

We are a design-build firm, which means design, planning, and construction live under one roof, managed by one team, accountable to one standard. There’s no handoff between an architect and a separate builder, no gap between what was designed and what gets built, and one point of accountability from the first conversation to the final walkthrough.

What that means for you: a more cohesive result, a smoother process, and a team that is genuinely invested in your outcome at every stage.

Happiness Guaranteed

Remodeling is one of the most personal investments a homeowner makes. It’s not just a financial decision — it’s an emotional one. You’re trusting someone with your home, your daily routine, and your vision for how you want to live.

Happiness Guaranteed isn’t a tagline. It’s the standard we hold ourselves to on every project. It means you should be deeply happy — not just with the finished space, but with the entire experience of getting there. The communication. The planning. The way surprises are handled. The feeling that your team was genuinely invested in your outcome.

We’ve built our process, our culture, and our team around that promise. And it shows — in our reviews, in our referrals, and in the awards that recognize not just our design work, but how we treat the people we work for.

See Our Awards
100% Woman-Owned

Our founder, April Bettinger, started the company in 2010 focused on both extraordinary craftsmanship and professionalism. She envisioned a nurturing atmosphere and a close-knit team, knowing these are keys to long-term relationships with clients, employees, and trade partners. 

At Nip Tuck, a women-led firm means our clients get better listeners, clearer communicators, and advocates who stay engaged long after the project is complete. It’s a different kind of partnership — and our clients feel it.

Nip Tuck Team
Planning Is Our Competitive Advantage

From the first phone call to the celebratory walkthrough, there’s a purposeful order to everything we do. We are expert planners — and that discipline is what makes everything else possible.

Before construction begins, every detail is resolved: floor plans finalized, finishes selected, structural requirements confirmed, and real pricing obtained from every trade partner involved in your project. By the time the first wall comes down, there are no open questions that could drive a cost or schedule surprise.

The result: our projects are completed within approximately 2% of the original estimated investment — not because we build in a large contingency buffer, but because the planning work is thorough enough that surprises are the exception, not the rule. The industry standard is 10–20%. We hold a different standard.

Communication is built into this process, not added on top of it. You’ll have a dedicated point of contact, weekly check-ins, a live project calendar, and a team that tells you what’s happening before you have to ask.

The Discipline Behind the Experience

Most remodeling firms grow by adding projects. We grow by building the team, systems, and oversight capacity to sustain the standard each project requires,  before we add to our load.

We’re deliberate about how many projects we carry at one time. That discipline is what makes the client experience consistent, not coincidental. Every project on our schedule gets the attention it deserves, because we don’t accept a project we can’t fully deliver.

Is Nip Tuck the Right Fit?
Who We're Built For

The homeowners who thrive with Nip Tuck share something in common: they’re investing in a home they love, and they want a partner who takes that as seriously as they do.

They’re not looking for the lowest bid. They’re looking for the right team — one that will listen carefully, design thoughtfully, and execute without surprises. They value planning over speed, quality over shortcuts, and a relationship built on trust and transparency.

Our clients tend to be:

 

Busy professionals and families who want a well-managed process they don’t have to micromanage
Homeowners who are staying — investing in the home they intend to live in and love for years to come
People who appreciate thoughtful design and want a space that’s genuinely, specifically theirs — not a catalog version of someone else’s style
Homeowners who approach their investment with a realistic, long-view perspective — focused on lasting value, not just a number on a spreadsheet
Those who want a trusted advisor in their corner — someone who will advocate for their vision, protect their investment, and tell them the truth

If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

Not every project needs to be a whole-home transformation to be a great fit. If you’re planning a primary bathroom or kitchen remodel and want it designed and executed with the same level of intention and craftsmanship — without structural complexity but without cutting corners either — we’d love to talk. The investment scale is different; the standard of care isn’t.

When We’re Probably Not the Right Match

We believe in being upfront, because a project that isn’t the right fit for us isn’t right for you either, and your time is too valuable to discover that six months in.

Nip Tuck may not be the right firm if:

 

You’re remodeling primarily to sell. Our work is designed for people who will live with it — not for staging or maximizing a quick resale return. We put too much care into each decision for that to be the right frame.
You’re planning to handle part of the work yourself. Our process is fully integrated from design through construction, and introducing outside scope mid-project creates gaps in accountability that we’re not able to absorb.
Your investment is fixed before the design process begins. Great design requires room to solve problems well. We won’t compromise the outcome by reverse-engineering a scope to hit a predetermined number — and we won’t ask you to, either.
You need to move fast. We plan thoroughly because that’s what produces reliable, on-time, on-investment results. Compressing the planning process to rush execution is how projects go sideways — and we won’t do that to you or to ourselves.

None of this is a judgment — it’s just honesty about where we do our best work. If you’re unsure whether we’re the right fit, reach out. A 15-minute conversation will tell us both what we need to know.

How is Nip Tuck different from other remodeling firms on Seattle’s Eastside?

The short answer: very few firms can deliver what we deliver simultaneously, and we’ve built everything about how we operate to make sure that stays true as we grow.

Design, planning, and construction live under one roof at Nip Tuck, managed by one team, accountable to one standard, all the way through. That cohesion shapes the entire client experience: your designer is aligned with your project manager, your project manager is aligned with every trade partner on site, and nothing gets lost in a handoff. The result is a project that feels intentional at every stage, not just at the design table.

We are also deliberate about how many projects we take on at one time. We grow purposefully, building our team and systems to sustain the level of communication and oversight each project requires before adding to our capacity. That discipline is what makes the client experience consistent, not coincidental.

What truly separates us is the pre-construction planning phase. Before a single wall comes down, we have resolved every detail: scope, design, finishes, structural requirements, and real pricing from every trade involved. That thoroughness is what keeps our projects on schedule without exception, holds our investment variance to approximately 2% — a fraction of the industry norm — and eliminates the surprises that derail most remodeling experiences. That combination of cohesive design-build delivery, schedule reliability, and planning discipline is genuinely rare. We’ve spent 16 years on the Eastside earning the reputation for it.
